snapshot.title: DAA-1 Video Feed Loss — GCS-01 Hangar 2

fields.subject: DAA-1 video feed missing on GCS-01
fields.description: GCS-01 on Hangar 2 console shows no video feed from DAA-1. Field camera is live, but video stream to GCS-01 is dropped. Rebooting the FIELD-RTR-1 router (192.168.88.1) may fix it.

activity.author: Field Technician – Hangar 2
activity.text: Reported to IT via phone. DAA-1 is showing a live feed on the local monitor, but not reaching GCS-01. FIELD-RTR-1 is the only network node between DAA-1 and GCS-01. Reboot suggested.

snapshot.instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging, as the DAA-1 feed is not critical to control recovery.
